shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin saw $132.3M in spot ETF inflows on July 17, indicating renewed institutional interest.
Regulatory uncertainty increased as US regulators missed the July 18 deadline for final stablecoin rules.
Escalating US-Iran tensions raise inflation risks and may delay Fed rate cuts, impacting global markets.
The Bitcoin Fear & Greed Index registered 29 (Fear) on July 20, reflecting market caution.
ETH is holding steady near $1,870 and is outperforming Bitcoin in some areas, supported by DeFi.
